node.title: Re^3: Summing numbers in a file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
there is no functional difference between the lexical file handles in your example and the traditional global file handles

Please see [id://11115734|this recent discussion] about lexical vs. bareword filehandles. In particular, open(N, "<", $filename); chomp (my $numbers = ); only gives warnings, while open(my $N, "<", $filename); chomp (my $numbers = <$M>); is of course a fatal error under [doc://strict]. Also, bareword filehandles [id://1083985|clash] with package names.
